tools.video-subtitle-burner.faqs.0.quest: What is the difference between burned and soft subtitles?
tools.video-subtitle-burner.faqs.0.answe: Burned (hard) subtitles are composited into the picture so any player shows them. Soft subtitles are a separate track that requires player support.
tools.video-subtitle-burner.faqs.2.quest: Why do my Chinese subtitles show as boxes?

tools.video-subtitle-burner.faqs.3.quest: Are my video and subtitles uploaded?

tools.video-subtitle-burner.faqs.4.answe: The video is re-encoded to H.264 while the audio is copied unchanged, so quality loss is minimal.

tools.currency-converter.metadata.descri: Free online currency converter with live exchange rates for 40+ currencies. No signup required — works offline with built-in fallback rates.
tools.currency-converter.title: Currency Converter
tools.currency-converter.description: Convert between 40+ world currencies with live exchange rates. Everything happens right in your browser — no signup, no data sent to us.
tools.currency-converter.guide.whatIs.bo: This tool converts any amount between 40+ world currencies using live exchange rates. Rates are fetched from free public APIs when you open the page; if the network is unavailable, built-in rates are used instead so the tool keeps working offline.
tools.currency-converter.guide.howTo.ite: Enter the amount you want to convert.
Choose the source currency (From) and target currency (To).
Read the converted amount and the unit rate instantly — no button needed.
tools.currency-converter.guide.tips.item: Use the Swap button to flip the currencies — the amount is carried over automatically.
The offline fallback is a snapshot and may be stale; prefer live rates when accuracy matters.
Rates refresh each time you open the page.
tools.currency-converter.faqs.0.question: How often are the exchange rates updated?
tools.currency-converter.faqs.0.answer: Rates are fetched from free public APIs (European Central Bank data via frankfurter.app, or open.er-api.com) each time the page loads. ECB rates update once per working day; open.er-api updates daily.
tools.currency-converter.faqs.1.question: Does it still work offline?
tools.currency-converter.faqs.1.answer: Yes. If every live API is unreachable, the tool falls back to built-in snapshot rates so you can still convert — just note they may be out of date.
tools.currency-converter.faqs.2.question: Which currencies are supported?
tools.currency-converter.faqs.2.answer: Over 40 major currencies, including USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY, HKD, KRW and many more.
tools.currency-converter.faqs.3.question: Is my data sent to a server?
tools.currency-converter.faqs.3.answer: No. The amount you enter is only processed in your browser. The only network request is to fetch public exchange rates.
tools.currency-converter.labels.offline: Offline: using built-in rates, which may be out of date
tools.image-to-relief.metadata.title: Image to 3D Relief - Free Online Tool
tools.image-to-relief.metadata.descripti: Free online tool to turn any photo into a 3D relief. Preview in 3D and export GLB or STL. No signup, fully private — processing happens in your browser.
tools.image-to-relief.title: Image to 3D Relief
tools.image-to-relief.description: Turn any photo into a 3D relief based on its brightness. Preview the result in full 3D and export as GLB or STL — all in your browser.
tools.image-to-relief.guide.whatIs.title: What is an image-to-3D relief tool?
This tool turns any photo into a 3D relief: it maps the image's brightness onto a mesh so bright areas stand out, then lets you preview the result with full 3D controls and export it as GLB (viewers/game engines) or STL (3D printing). Everything runs locally in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
tools.image-to-relief.guide.howTo.title: How to use
Upload an image (JPG, PNG or WebP).
Adjust grid resolution, relief strength and smoothing, then click Generate 3D.
Preview the mesh (drag to rotate, scroll to zoom), then download GLB or STL.
tools.image-to-relief.guide.tips.title: Tips
tools.image-to-relief.guide.tips.items.0: Images with strong contrast produce more dramatic reliefs.
tools.image-to-relief.guide.tips.items.1: Increase smoothing to reduce noise on detailed photos.
tools.image-to-relief.guide.tips.items.2: For 3D printing, choose STL — the model is automatically laid flat for slicing.
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.0.question: How is the 3D relief generated?
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.0.answer: The tool reads each pixel's brightness (luminance) and lifts the mesh height accordingly — bright areas rise, dark areas stay low. Parameters let you control resolution, height and smoothing.
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.1.question: What's the difference between GLB and STL?
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.1.answer: GLB is a general 3D format for viewers and game engines. STL is the standard format for 3D printing and is exported pre-oriented flat.
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.2.question: Is my image uploaded?
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.2.answer: No. All processing happens in your browser; your image never leaves your device.
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.3.question: Why does my result look flat?
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.3.answer: Low-contrast images produce subtle reliefs. Try increasing relief strength, lowering smoothing, or using a photo with stronger lighting contrast.

tools.image-to-printmaking.metadata.titl: Image to Printmaking - Free Online Tool
tools.image-to-printmaking.metadata.desc: Free online tool to turn photos into black & white printmaking art with an adjustable threshold and instant preview. No uploads — all in your browser.
tools.image-to-printmaking.title: Image to Printmaking
tools.image-to-printmaking.description: Turn any photo into a black & white printmaking effect. A precise threshold removes grayscale transitions so only pure black and white remain — like a woodcut or screen print.
This tool converts any photo into a black & white printmaking style in one click. A precise threshold algorithm removes grayscale transitions so only pure black and pure white remain, mimicking traditional woodcut, screen print or old letterpress effects.
tools.image-to-printmaking.guide.howTo.i: Upload an image (JPG, PNG or WebP).
Drag the threshold slider to balance black and white areas — the preview updates instantly.
Download the final printmaking image as PNG.
tools.image-to-printmaking.guide.tips.it: Photos with strong contrast produce bolder printmaking effects.
Lower thresholds turn more of the image black; higher thresholds keep more white.
Enable Invert to swap black and white for a negative-like look.
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.0.questi: How does the printmaking effect work?
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.0.answer: The tool converts each pixel to grayscale, then applies a threshold: pixels darker than the threshold become black, the rest become white. No gray tones remain, which creates the classic woodcut look.
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.1.questi: Is my image uploaded to a server?
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.1.answer: No. Everything runs locally in your browser — your image never leaves your device.
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.2.questi: What is the best threshold value?
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.2.answer: It depends on your image. Start around 128 and adjust: lower values make more of the image black, higher values keep more white. Use the live preview to find the best balance.
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.3.questi: Can I get the opposite colors?
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.3.answer: Yes, enable the Invert option to swap black and white.
tools.image-to-printmaking.upload.drop: Upload an image to create printmaking art
tools.image-emboss.metadata.title: Image Emboss - Free Online Tool
tools.image-emboss.metadata.description: Free online tool to turn any photo into an embossed stone/metal carving effect. Adjustable strength with instant preview. No uploads — all processing happens in your browser.
tools.image-emboss.title: Image Emboss
tools.image-emboss.description: Turn any photo into an embossed relief with a pixel-difference algorithm that extracts edges and contours — like stone carving or metal stamping.
tools.image-emboss.guide.whatIs.title: What is an image emboss tool?
tools.image-emboss.guide.whatIs.body.0: This tool applies an emboss filter to any photo: a pixel-difference algorithm highlights edges and contours by comparing each pixel with its neighbors, producing a realistic stone-carving or metal-stamping look in seconds.
tools.image-emboss.guide.howTo.title: How to use
tools.image-emboss.guide.howTo.items.0: Upload an image (JPG, PNG or WebP).
tools.image-emboss.guide.howTo.items.1: Adjust the strength slider to control how pronounced the emboss is — the preview updates instantly.
tools.image-emboss.guide.howTo.items.2: Download the embossed image as PNG.
tools.image-emboss.guide.tips.title: Tips
tools.image-emboss.guide.tips.items.0: Images with strong edges and details produce the most dramatic emboss.
tools.image-emboss.guide.tips.items.1: Lower strength gives a subtle texture; higher strength creates a bold stone-carved look.
tools.image-emboss.guide.tips.items.2: Enable Invert to flip which side of the edges is raised.
tools.image-emboss.faqs.0.question: How does the emboss effect work?
tools.image-emboss.faqs.0.answer: The tool compares each pixel with its neighbors using a convolution kernel. Areas with little change become mid-gray, while edges become bright or dark — creating the 3D carved look.
tools.image-emboss.faqs.1.question: Is my image uploaded to a server?
tools.image-emboss.faqs.1.answer: No. Everything runs locally in your browser — your image never leaves your device.
tools.image-emboss.faqs.2.question: What is the best strength value?
tools.image-emboss.faqs.2.answer: It depends on your image. Start at 1.0 and adjust: lower values give a subtle texture, higher values create a bolder, deeper carving.
tools.image-emboss.faqs.3.question: Why is the result mostly gray?
tools.image-emboss.faqs.3.answer: That's the classic emboss look — flat areas render as mid-gray, and only edges stand out in light and dark. Increase the strength for a stronger effect.

tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.0.answer: Yes, completely free. No registration, no watermarks, no hidden fees. All processing happens locally in your browser.
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.1.question: What ID sizes are supported?
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.1.answer: We support US passport/visa (2×2 in), EU/UK passport (35×45 mm), China passport (33×48 mm), Japan passport (45×35 mm), 1×1 inch (25×25 mm), small ID (30×40 mm), plus Chinese 1-inch (25×35 mm) and 2-inch (35×49 mm) photos. All sizes output at 300 DPI.
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.2.question: Can I change the background color?
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.2.answer: Yes. Choose white, blue, red or gray — the chosen color is placed behind your photo.
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.3.question: What if my photo isn't perfectly centered?
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.3.answer: Use the X/Y offset sliders to move the photo and the zoom slider to control how large the face appears.
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.4.question: Is my photo uploaded to a server?
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.4.answer: No. The AI background removal and all rendering happen entirely in your browser using WebAssembly — your photo never leaves your device.

tools.background-replace.faqs.0.question: Is the background replace free?
tools.background-replace.faqs.0.answer: Yes. This tool is completely free with no signup, no watermarks, and no usage limits. Everything runs locally in your browser.
tools.background-replace.faqs.1.question: What background options are available?
tools.background-replace.faqs.1.answer: You can choose a solid color (with a palette and custom color picker), a two-color gradient, a custom background image, or a blurred version of the original photo with adjustable strength.
tools.background-replace.faqs.2.question: Is my photo uploaded to a server?
tools.background-replace.faqs.2.answer: No. The AI background removal uses WebAssembly and runs entirely in your browser, so your photo never leaves your device.
tools.background-replace.faqs.3.question: What file formats can I use?
